item.title: Nobel Peace Prize for 2026 to Navanethem Pillay
item.description:
📝 The Norwegian Nobel Committee has decided to award the Nobel Peace Prize for 2026 to Navanethem “Navi” Pillay for her efforts to promote peace and international law. Navi Pillay has also contributed to strengthen the institutions of international law. Peace requires justice.
🔗 Read more: https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/2026/press-release/

item.title: Germany transforms former coal mines into Europe's largest lake landscape
item.description:
📝 There is even a community in the region called Neu-Seeland, around which the water landscape created from former open-cast mines has developed. A holiday region is growing step by step from a former lignite mining area. The rapid introduction of neutral river water fulfils an important purpose: it prevents acidic water from the tipping areas from entering the lakes.
🔗 Read more: https://www.euronews.com/2026/04/14/almost-like-lake-como-germany-transforms-former-coal-mines-into-europes-largest-lake-lands

item.title: OpenAI fires three safety researchers for "mishandling research information"
item.description:
📝 Jasmine Wang, Tomek Korbak, and Mikita Balesni, the three safety researchers that OpenAI fired last week, have published an open letter denying the firm’s claims that they mishandled sensitive information outside of established company procedures and warned that their dismissal signals a chilling effect that will have ripple effects across the company’s culture. They also denied engaging with external parties outside the mandates of their jobs. “We have always encouraged that and always will.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/08/fired-openai-safety-researchers-dispute-misconduct-claims-warn-of-chilling-effect/

item.title: Programming Isn't Special
item.description:

item.title: The Hetzner Cloud network stack – history and technical overview
item.description:
📝 With the launch of Hetzner Cloud and the introduction of network features like Private Networks and Firewalls, we introduced Open vSwitch. Private network traffic is encapsulated using Virtual eXtensible LAN (VXLAN) and a unique Virtual Network Identifier (VNI) per private network. The host network stack ensures that only members attached to the respective private network can send or receive traffic.
🔗 Read more: https://www.hetzner.com/blog/the-hetzner-cloud-network-stack-history-and-technical-overview/

item.title: Iranian campaign planted fake articles in real U.S. publications using ChatGPT
Scam American companies are using to manipulate ingredient gets listed first
item.description:
📝 Wall Street Apes@WallStreetApesThere is a scam American companies are using to manipulate what ingredient gets listed as the first main ingredient on products Take Smuckers, strawberries is the first ingredient. That way, each of them weigh less This allows the word strawberries to be listed on the label as the first ingredient, giving the impression that it's mostly strawberries. In reality, it's mostly sugar.
